description: Reports whether the source RecordSet of a grid session has importable changes that the grid has not picked up yet: changes that would alter the rows a PULL loads into the grid or how those rows are validated. Clients use this to decide whether to prompt the user to synchronize (PULL). A new source version is not by itself an importable change; compare sessionSourceVersionNumber with currentSourceVersionNumber to detect one. This compares the metadata of two RecordSet revisions rather than diffing their rows, so neither answer predicts exactly what a PULL would do. When changes is not empty, a PULL may still change nothing: for example a CSV that was re-saved with different bytes but the same rows is reported as a DATA change. When changes is empty, a PULL would leave the grid's rows unchanged, but it always re-validates them against the currently bound JSON schema, so validation results can still change (see JSON_SCHEMA).

gridSessionId.description: The sessionId of the grid session this status was computed for.

sourceEntityId.description: The synId of the source RecordSet this grid session was created from.

sessionSourceVersionNumber.description: The version of the source RecordSet the grid was last synchronized to. Null when the grid has never been synchronized to a specific version (see NO_BASELINE).

currentSourceVersionNumber.description: The current version of the source RecordSet.

changes.description: Each importable way in which the source RecordSet differs from the revision the grid was last synchronized to. Empty when there are no changes.
